purpose: Developer-authored synthetic trace/diagnostic snapshots, not real evidence, upstream detector accuracy, independent annotation or a blind benchmark.
policy: The evaluator materializes declared fixture views without calling upstream analyzers. Expected categories are authored separately. Quiet temporal/numerical views mean no warning was declared in this fixture; source independence remains unknown. Primary reasons may only quote an Inconclusive decision explanation, and additional findings must never assert new verdict causes.
